name: Poha
steps: Wash poha gently and drain immediately.
Let it sit for 5 minutes to soften.
Heat oil in a pan.
Add mustard seeds, let them splutter.
Add curry leaves and green chillies.
Add peanuts and fry until golden.
Add chopped onions, sauté until soft.
Add diced potatoes and cook covered.
Add turmeric powder and salt.
Add the softened poha and mix gently.
Cook on low heat for 2-3 minutes.
Squeeze lemon juice before serving.
Garnish with coriander and serve hot.

name: Varan Bhaat
steps: Pressure cook toor dal with turmeric until very soft.
Mash the dal well.
Add jaggery and mix.
Heat ghee in a small pan.
Add cumin seeds and asafoetida.
Pour tempering over dal.
Cook rice separately.
Mix dal with hot rice.
Serve with ghee on top.
